attempts.code:
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]

cands = grasp_candidates("purple_pen")
cand = sorted(cands, key=lambda c: -c.get("score", 0))[0]
res = grasp(cand)

if res["holding_something"]:
    # Move well above holder
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=0.25)
    # Pitch the gripper so the pen tilts vertically down into the cup
    # The held pen lies along the 'side' vector (perpendicular to approach and finger_axis).
    # Tilting the gripper by rotating approach/side makes the pen point downwards into the cup.
    # To pitch: approach tilted, or tilt towards horizontal so pen becomes vertical.
    pose = gripper_pose()
    side = pose["side"]
    # We want pen axis (currently along side) to align close to vertical [0, 0, -1].
    # Rotating gripper about finger_axis by 90 degrees puts side along vertical!
    new_approach = [side[0], side[1], 0]
    norm_a = math.sqrt(new_approach[0]**2 + new_approach[1]**2)
    if norm_a > 1e-4:
        new_approach = [new_approach[0]/norm_a, new_approach[1]/norm_a, 0]
    else:
        new_approach = [1, 0, 0]
    
    # Try reaching with tilted orientation above the holder opening
    target_z = obs["table_z"] + holder["rim_height"] + 0.10
    move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=new_approach, finger_axis=pose["finger_axis"], path="line")
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
    check("purple_pen", "magenta_holder")
